question: Which major deities are included in the vision or scope described in this sequence?
premises: Brahma, Viṣṇu, Yama, and Indra are named.
They are listed together as part of the same scope.
inference: The scope includes Brahma, Viṣṇu, Yama, Indra, Varuṇa, and Vāyu.
plain_english: Brahma, Viṣṇu, Yama, and Indra, and also Varuṇa and Vāyu.
